title: Generated rational matrix right kernel resource
objective: Add a generated FmpqMatrix-to-FmpqMatrix right-kernel operation that computes and canonicalizes the rational kernel entirely inside FLINT-owned storage, with deterministic lifecycle, no packed RationalBuffer conversion, and scaling competitive with Sage.

oracles: current typed-Python rational kernel from RREF
A*K.transpose() equals zero and basis is canonical RREF

handoff.summary: Added a generated declared FmpqMatrix-to-FmpqMatrix right-kernel operation. The host adapter reverses source columns, performs exactly one FLINT RREF, and constructs the reversed free-variable basis directly in canonical row-RREF form. This avoids packed RationalBuffer conversion, uniform limb capacity, repeated elimination, and hidden FLINT-to-FLINT copying. Exact differential tests cover randomized rank profiles, degenerate dimensions, 4097-bit skew entries, source preservation, canonicality, closed resources, deterministic cleanup, and sanitizer-backed lifecycle fuzzing. On deterministic 60x90, 80x120, and 120x180 rational matrices, generated-resource medians were 22.28 ms, 63.80 ms, and 229.82 ms versus current-public 816.67 ms, 3781.20 ms, and 38621.09 ms, and SageMath 46.56 ms, 101.08 ms, and 411.10 ms.
risks: The generated native-host compilation cache does not currently include transitive C header contents in its key. Reproduction: build packages/flint generated FFI, modify only packages/flint/include/sagejs/fmpq_matrix_ffi.h, then rerun SAGEJS_FLINT_PREFIX=/home/user/sagejs/packages/flint/.native/prefix pnpm --dir packages/flint build:ffi; the cached addon is reused until packages/flint/.native/ffi-host-cache is moved aside. This belongs in a compiler-infrastructure lane.

pnpm architecture:check and pnpm test:portable reach the package-graph check and fail only because python-stdlib owns 971105 source bytes against the shared 970000-byte lazy budget. package-graph.json is intentionally outside this lane's claims and must be handled deliberately by integration.
The FmpqMatrix resource target remains wasm=False. The ownership and mathematical operation are host-independent at the declaration level, but browser lowering is not established in this lane.
next_steps: Route the public rational Matrix.right_kernel implementation through the generated resource and benchmark end-to-end construction and result ownership.
Fix the generated native-host cache key to include transitive headers, then add a regression proving header-only adapter changes rebuild the addon.
Integrate the package-size budget explicitly rather than shrinking generated readable wrappers or weakening the ratchet.
